behavior_in_tests: The tests cover canonicalization, rotation boundaries, long chains, caller consistency, and npm test, but do not verify the documented HKDF, AES-GCM, nonce, authentication, chain-byte construction, non-finite rejection, or the 8,000-event limit.

hardcoded_solution: solution/solve.sh directly writes a complete replacement src/seal.js containing the final implementation. The git-log command does not contribute to deriving or applying the repair.

valid_failure_modes: The verifier requires apt, curl, the NodeSource setup endpoint, and an online uv installation at test time. Network or external-service failure can therefore cause failure unrelated to the submitted implementation.

informative_test_structure: The Python tests have descriptive function names, but their bodies and much of the JavaScript protocol test are compressed into dense one-line expressions with minimal organization or explanatory comments.

pinned_dependencies: The Dockerfile installs Node through the floating deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x script and then installs the resulting unpinned system package; the runtime toolchain is therefore not fully version-pinned.

oracle_investigates: The oracle script does not inspect the documentation, source history, or repository state to determine the repair; it writes the final implementation verbatim, with only an irrelevant git-log printout.
